title: About
tagline: Open source batch printing for Windows, Mac and Linux. No 15-file limit, no Adobe required, no $149 license fee.

unavailable.title: No updates published on the {{channel}} channel
unavailable.detail: Its update file was not found, so there is nothing to install. Nothing has been released on this channel yet, or the releases are not public. Pluryprint keeps working as it is; check again later.

available.title: Version {{version}} is available
available.verifiedNote: The download is checked against Pluryprint's release signature before anything is installed, and no administrator rights are needed.
available.verifiedNoteLinuxAppImage: The download is checked against Pluryprint's release signature before anything is installed. The new version replaces this AppImage file where it is, so no administrator rights are needed.
available.verifiedNoteLinuxDeb: The download is checked against Pluryprint's release signature before anything is installed. Pluryprint was installed from the .deb package, so the system asks for an administrator password to install the update.
available.verifiedNoteLinux: The download is checked against Pluryprint's release signature before anything is installed. An AppImage is replaced where it is; a .deb installation asks for an administrator password.

updates.deferred: Reminder postponed. Check again whenever you like.
updates.skipped: Skipping {{version}}. A newer release will still be offered.

install.majorMessage: {{version}} is a major update from {{current}} and may change how Pluryprint works. If you rely on a particular workflow, read the release notes first.
install.restartDetail: Restart Pluryprint to start using it.
install.nothing: There is no installable update for this platform yet. Download it from the release page instead.
install.signatureInvalid: The downloaded update failed its signature check and was not installed. Nothing on this computer was changed. Try again later, or download the release from the release page.
install.failed: The update could not be installed: {{error}}

ipcUnavailable: IPC unavailable: {{error}}. This is expected when running the standalone Vite dev server (no Tauri host). Run {{command}} to test the real bridge.

footer.license: Pluryprint is free software licensed under {{license}}. No telemetry, no cloud, no account.
